guide_title.speaker: narrator
guide_title.text: Welcome to Tung Tung Tung Sahur Island! Tap Play to start drumming!

guide_welcome.speaker: sahur
guide_welcome.text: Tung Tung Tung Sahur! Tap the glowing golden drum right in front of us!

guide_starter_pop.speaker: narrator
guide_starter_pop.text: Awesome! Golden Drum Stars, a Totem Seed, and a Free Roulette Spin!

guide_tap_block.speaker: narrator
guide_tap_block.text: Tap any glowing Mystery Drum to bonk it three times! Tung, Tung, Tung!

guide_combo_sahur.speaker: sahur
guide_combo_sahur.text: Tung! Tung! Tung! Sahur! Rainbow shockwave combo!

guide_boing_hint.speaker: narrator
guide_boing_hint.text: Boing! Cappuccino cloud bounce! Let's spin the wheel first!

guide_ready_tralalero.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_tralalero.text: We're ready for Tralalero Tralala on Sneaker Coral Beach!

guide_ready_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_bombardiro.text: Awesome club! Let's wake Bombardiro Crocodilo on Cloud Peak!

guide_ready_patapim.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_patapim.text: Zoom sneakers ready! Time to meet Brr Brr Patapim in the Jungle!

guide_ready_king.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_king.text: Super Taiko power! Let's challenge the Golden Sahur King!

vo_wpn_bat.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_bat.text: Wooden Kentungan Bat! Time to drum!

vo_wpn_gong.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_gong.text: Whoa! The Bronze Temple Gong! Ring-a-ding!

vo_wpn_taiko.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_taiko.text: Boom boom! Neon Thunder Taiko Drum!

vo_wpn_rainbow.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_rainbow.text: Jackpot! The Rainbow Mega Sahur Hammer!

vo_totem_tier1.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier1.text: Look! Our sleepy cottage woke up and started dancing!

vo_totem_tier2.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier2.text: Hooray! The Sahur Rhythm Pavilion is fountaining stars!

vo_totem_tier3.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier3.text: Amazing! The Ultimate Golden Sahur Tower is raining stars!

helper_cappuccina_wake.speaker: cappuccina
helper_cappuccina_wake.text: Ballerina Cappuccina! Pirouette and latte stars for you!

helper_bananini_wake.speaker: bananini
helper_bananini_wake.text: Chimpanzini Bananini! Ooh-ooh ah-ah, banana stars!

helper_lirili_wake.speaker: lirili
helper_lirili_wake.text: Lirili Larila! Tick-tock cactus march, here come the stars!

helper_assassino_wake.speaker: sahur
helper_assassino_wake.text: Cappuccino Assassino! Ninja drum roll, catch these stars!

fairy_pot_max.speaker: cappuccina
fairy_pot_max.text: All four Sahur Towers are maxed! Bonus Rainbow Star Fountain!

fairy_need_stars.speaker: narrator
fairy_need_stars.text: Let's collect more Drum Stars or wake the earlier Boss first!

wheel_open.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_open.text: Spin the Golden Sahur Roulette Wheel!

wheel_spinning.speaker: sahur
wheel_spinning.text: Round and round the golden drum wheel goes!

wheel_jackpot.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_jackpot.text: Mega Sahur Jackpot! Bonus stars and a shield heart!

vo_drop_seed.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_seed.text: A Magic Totem Seed! Tap Totem to wake a Brainrot buddy!

vo_drop_wheel.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_wheel.text: Free Spin Token! Let's spin the Golden Drum Wheel!

vo_drop_mango.speaker: narrator
vo_drop_mango.text: Yummy! Croissant and Mango Smoothie Feast!

vo_drop_latte.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_latte.text: Ballerina Latte Zoom! Super fast feet and a shield heart!

vo_drop_bananini.speaker: bananini
vo_drop_bananini.text: Haha! A dancing Mini Chimpanzini Bananini popped out!

vo_drop_confetti.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_confetti.text: Pop! Confetti fireworks and Mini Ballerina Cappuccina!

vo_drop_toot.speaker: lirili
vo_drop_toot.text: Pffft! Hehe, silly toot cushion and Mini Lirili Larila!

vo_gear_boots.speaker: sahur
vo_gear_boots.text: Blue Sneaker Speed Boots! Zoom zoom, super fast!

vo_gear_crown.speaker: sahur
vo_gear_crown.text: The Golden Crescent Crown! Five glowing shield hearts!

vo_gear_cape.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_cape.text: Ballerina Star Ribbon Cape! Super star magnet!

vo_boss_alert.speaker: sahur
vo_boss_alert.text: Uh-oh! That drum woke up a Giant Brainrot Boss!

vo_pet_cappuccina.speaker: cappuccina
vo_pet_cappuccina.text: Hehe! Mini Cappuccina loves pats! Twirl twirl!

vo_pet_bananini.speaker: bananini
vo_pet_bananini.text: Ooh-ooh! Happy Mini Bananini gives you bonus stars!

vo_pet_lirili.speaker: lirili
vo_pet_lirili.text: Tick-tock giggle! Mini Lirili Larila is so happy!

boss_tralalero_spawn.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_spawn.text: Tralalero Tralala! Check out my three shiny blue sneakers!

boss_tralalero_boing.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_boing.text: Haha! My sneaker wave is too splashy! Boing on a cappuccino cloud!

boss_tralalero_ouch.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_ouch.text: Whoa! Careful with my fresh blue sneakers!

boss_tralalero_defeat.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_defeat.text: Awesome rhythm! Let's do the shark sneaker dance! Take my trophy!

vo_win_tralalero.speaker: narrator
vo_win_tralalero.text: Hooray! Tralalero Tralala is our dancing friend! Trophy one!

boss_bombardiro_spawn.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_spawn.text: Bombardiro Crocodilo! Vroom vroom, twin propellers spinning!

boss_bombardiro_boing.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_boing.text: Whoosh! My propeller breeze bounced you onto a foam cloud!

boss_bombardiro_ouch.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_ouch.text: Bzzzt! My aviator goggles are wobbling!

boss_bombardiro_defeat.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_defeat.text: Mayday of fun! I love your drum beat! Here's my trophy!

vo_win_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
vo_win_bombardiro.text: Yeah! Bombardiro Crocodilo joined our parade! Two trophies won!

boss_patapim_spawn.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_spawn.text: Brr Brr Patapim! Who's drumming in my leafy nose forest?!

boss_patapim_boing.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_boing.text: Ho ho! My big root feet made a bouncy cloud! Grab Blue Sneakers first!

boss_patapim_ouch.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_ouch.text: Brr brr! That tickles my giant forest nose!

boss_patapim_defeat.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_defeat.text: Patapim party time! My big feet love this beat! Take my trophy!

vo_win_patapim.speaker: narrator
vo_win_patapim.text: Amazing! Brr Brr Patapim is dancing with us! Three trophies!

boss_king_spawn.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_spawn.text: Tung Tung Tung Sahur! Behold the Golden Sahur Titan King!

boss_king_boing.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_boing.text: Boom boom! Bring a Neon Taiko or Mega Hammer to match my beat!

boss_king_ouch.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_ouch.text: Clang! What a powerful Sahur drum combo!

boss_king_defeat.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_defeat.text: Magnificent rhythm! You are the Grand Sahur Champion! Take the crown!

vo_win_king.speaker: narrator
vo_win_king.text: We did it! All four Brainrot Bosses are dancing in our Sunrise Parade!

vo_finale_parade.speaker: sahur
vo_finale_parade.text: Grand Sunrise Sahur Parade! Everyone dance and celebrate!

vo_keep_playing.speaker: narrator
vo_keep_playing.text: Welcome back to Sahur Island! Let's keep drumming and popping surprises!

vo_chaos_on.speaker: sahur
vo_chaos_on.text: Brainrot Chaos Mode on! Every Mystery Drum pops extra silly surprises!

vo_chaos_off.speaker: narrator
vo_chaos_off.text: Normal Island Mode! Sunny rhythm adventure!

sahur_sleepy_zzz.speaker: narrator
sahur_sleepy_zzz.text: Shhh! That Giant Boss is still snoring! Let's win the earlier trophy first!
